about_the_game:
GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

  • 20+ hour dark fantasy JRPG built in RPG Maker

  • Lush backgrounds and hand-drawn event CGs

  • Expressive pixel art and detailed character sprites

  • A brutal, dog-eat-dog world of betrayal and survival

  • Fully voiced by veteran Japanese voice actors

STORY

A beautiful, blonde-haired debutante, born into privilege as the daughter of a noble house, but whose fortunes take a turn for the worse after her father’s untimely death...

Betrayed by her servants, stripped of her wealth, and saddled with crushing debt, she stands at the edge of ruin. Only the quick action of her one-armed butler, J, has spared her from her enemies’ grasp.

J remains by her side, guiding her through their new life together—and entrusting her with a pair of enchanted hand cannons known as Drive.

Armed with Drive and a renewed determination, Alice rises once more to defy her fate!

Will she reclaim her pride as a noble?

Or tumble headlong into darkness?

This fallen princess must now choose her path forward.

CHARACTERS

Alice Dietrich

Yuzunagi

Once the beloved young princess of House Dietrich, a proud noble family brought low after her father’s sudden death. With no home and a mountain of inherited debt, Alice was abandoned by over a hundred servants, save for one: her one-armed butler, J.

She now lives in her rented home downtown, taking on odd quests alongside J to chip away at her family’s obligations. Her dream is to cast off her burden and reclaim the noble life she once knew.

Hilda Geisler

Ao Inukai

Charismatic, cunning, and cruel, Hilda is the leader of Eden, a powerful religious order that stretches deep into the halls of government.

Thanks to her stunning beauty and political savvy, she rose from slum-born obscurity to become the king’s own confidante. In all but name, she now rules the nation—but beneath her holy title lies a ruthless heart, one that erupts in fury whenever the world denies her.

J

—

A taciturn man of strength and mystery, J is Alice’s one-armed butler and her only remaining servant after her family’s fall. Once a soldier, he lost his dominant hand saving a village woman from raiders, and later wandered the land before finding purpose again at House Dietrich.

Though he seldom speaks of the past, his skills in combat and command remain undeniable. Today, he continues to stand at Alice’s side not just as her caretaker, but as a quiet mentor in a world that’s seemingly turned against her.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains crude humor and some mild innuendo, including character designs and battle animations.

name: Princessfall
short_description: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.
